title.text: T11 · A mic and a pencil beside the bar's camera

legend.text:
What changes: while a walk is minimized, the recording bar on Explore, Navigate and Chronicle's sections other than Memories holds a mic and a pencil beside its camera, each the same 44 pt white button, then Stop. On Memories the bar keeps none, as today (its band has all three).

The line: four buttons leave room for the time alone ("< 1 min", "12 min", "1:45"); the distance moves to the bar's spoken name. At 320 px one more thing must go: the chevron (recommended; the line is still the way back to the walk) or the red dot.

The mic records in place: the line shows the memo's time; Discard takes the camera's place and Stop and save (purple, as on the walk screen) the mic's; the pencil's place stays empty so Stop never moves. Leaving the tab saves the memo; Stop refuses under a memo, as today.

The pencil opens the note the walk screen's note button opens, on this tab, joined to the walk.

Rests on: VISION Always, "Capture is one tap away on every screen you walk or capture from"; E-tabs-9. Extends NV9, 0048 and 0240.

Not in it: no count, no accent colour, no new word.

choice.text: Your choice at 320 px: A leaves the chevron out (the dot stays, so the bar still says it is recording); B keeps the chevron and leaves the dot out. Neither fits both: at 320 px the line has 40 px with both.

title2.text: Two states the approved drawing did not show

legend2.text:
Found while planning the build (decision 0252: a state the drawing did not show waits for your look).

1. Discard from the bar: the walk screen keeps a discarded memo for Undo, so the bar does too. The pill is the walk screen's own, "Voice memo discarded" with Undo, set on the page's ground just above the bar, so it covers none of the tab's controls. It goes when Undo is used, or after five seconds as on the walk screen today (T48 will change both together).

2. The bar's words ("Hold to stop", "A voice memo is recording. Save it first.", "Too short, not kept", a save that failed): with four buttons the line has about 66 px at 320 px, so a refusal would wrap into five or six lines. Recommended: the words take a line of their own across the bar, above the buttons, which stay where they are; they go after three seconds (six for a failure), as today. Other: they wrap where the time is, as today, and the bar grows tall.

Not in it: no new word, no count, no colour.
